Whitefield, Bangalore

Professional Summary
Frontend-focused engineer with hands-on experience building customer-facing web applications. Proficient in component-driven development, responsive UI implementation, and collaborating in Agile teams. Available with a 60 days notice period.

Technical Skills
React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, Redux, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Agile, Git, Linux

Work Experience
Frontend Engineer, Accenture (Nov 2021 - Present)
- Implemented modular Next.js pages and reusable React.js components for a client portal, improving page load interactivity and enabling server-side rendering optimizations using TypeScript and Redux.
- Led responsive redesigns using Tailwind CSS and CSS utilities to standardize components, reducing CSS code duplication by measurable margins and improving cross-browser consistency.
- Collaborated with backend and DevOps teams in Agile sprints, using Git and Linux-based CI environments to streamline deployments and reduce rollback incidents.

UI Engineer, Razorpay (Feb 2021 - Oct 2021)
- Developed payment UI flows and Next.js landing pages with React.js and TypeScript, improving conversion metrics through iterative A/B work and performance tuning.
- Built consistent component library styled with Tailwind CSS and CSS best practices to accelerate feature delivery across teams.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies, maintained feature branches in Git, and validated builds in Linux-based staging environments.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
